request.deadline: 12-month delivery period from August 2026 to July 2027
deliverables: Maintain and develop Eternl frontend across web, browser extension, Android, and iOS
Maintain backend infrastructure including nodes, indexers, application servers, metadata services, monitoring, and incident response
Provide user support through Discord, Telegram, public channels, project support, wiki updates, and educational videos
Enhance governance tooling including DRep dashboards, proposal browsers, in-wallet voting, and proposal creation
Fund periodic independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics
Convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, return excess Ada to the treasury, and publish monitoring/reporting information
request.what: Treasury withdrawal for 12 months of Eternl operations, maintenance, and improvements, including frontend and backend maintenance and development, backend infrastructure, user support, administration, audits, and day-to-day operations.

claims.claim: Eternl requests ₳2,350,000, valued at about $0.1787 per Ada, to cover a $420,000 annual operating cost for 12 months.
The proposal funds 6.0 FTE distributed across 10 contributors at $70,000 per FTE.
Eternl says it has about 100,000 browser-extension installs and about 30,000 Android and iOS installs.
Eternl says that if about 4.2% of its install base, roughly 5,500 users, buy the Pro plan, that income would fully cover the annual $420,000 cost.
Eternl commits to convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, place it in a public company wallet, and return any Ada above that amount to the treasury.
The audits allocation is for independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics in February 2027 and August 2027, not for technical security audits.
Eternl commits to semiannual repayment assessments and to repay treasury surplus until $420,000 worth of Ada has been repaid, with a possible additional donation capped at $210,000 worth of Ada.
Eternl claims 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.
Eternl states its main UI will not be open-source, while some libraries used in Eternl will be published through the npm registry.
Eternl says that without treasury funding it may let developers go, scale down to essential maintenance, shift focus outside Cardano, or remove the free option if paid licenses are insufficient.

summary: The document requests ₳2,350,000 for a one-year operational runway for Eternl, with a stated $420,000 annual cost, a future Pro-plan sustainability path, public custody and repayment commitments, limited fund-use audits, and several adoption and ecosystem-impact claims that are mostly asserted rather than evidenced in the anchor text.
